WITH PopulationStats AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_population,
           SUM(CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 0 AND 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS children_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN age >= 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seniors_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
    WHERE snapshot = (select max(snapshot) from estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)
      AND is_in_population = TRUE
)
SELECT ROUND((children_count / NULLIF(total_population, 0)) * 100, 2) AS children_percentage,
       ROUND((seniors_count / NULLIF(total_population, 0)) * 100, 2) AS seniors_percentage
FROM PopulationStats
LIMIT 100;
raw_question: ما نسبة الأطفال (0–14 سنة) وكبار السن (65+) في التركيبة السكانية؟
